papers.title: TurboVLA: Real-Time Vision-Language-Action Model at 32 Hz on an RTX 4090 with <1 GB VRAM
papers.summary: Vision-language-action (VLA) models commonly adopt an LLM-centric $V \to L \to A$ pathway, where visual observations are projected into the representation space of a large language model before being decoded into robot actions. Although effective, this design incurs substantial computation and memory overhead at every policy invocation. In this work, we introduce TurboVLA, a new VLA paradigm that reformulates the conventional $V \to L \to A$ pathway as a direct $V + L \to A$ mapping. Instead of using a large language model as the central interface between perception and action, TurboVLA independently encodes visual observations and language instructions, directly exchanges information between them through lightweight bidirectional vision-language interaction, and predicts continuous action chunks with a compact decoder. This simple design constructs task-conditioned representations directly from visual and linguistic features, significantly reducing the computational and memory costs of VLA inference. On LIBERO, TurboVLA achieves 97.7% average success with only 0.2B parameters, 31.2 ms inference latency, and 0.9 GB inference VRAM on a consumer-grade RTX 4090, matching or outperforming substantially larger VLA policies. These results establish TurboVLA as a simple and effective alternative to the prevailing LLM-centric VLA paradigm, offering a new perspective on how vision, language, and action can be connected for efficient robotic manipulation. Code is available at https://github.com/H-EmbodVis/TurboVLA.
papers.title_zh: TurboVLA：在具有 <1 GB VRAM 的 RTX 4090 上以 32 Hz 运行的实时视觉-语言-动作模型
papers.summary_zh: 视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型通常采用以 LLM 为中心的 $V \to L \to A$ 路径，其中视觉观察在被解码为机器人动作之前被投影到大型语言模型的表示空间中。尽管有效，但这种设计在每次策略调用时都会产生大量的计算和内存开销。在这项工作中，我们引入了 TurboVLA，一种新的 VLA 范例，它将传统的 $V \to L \to A$ 路径重新表述为直接 $V + L \to A$ 映射。 TurboVLA 没有使用大型语言模型作为感知和动作之间的中心接口，而是独立编码视觉观察和语言指令，通过轻量级双向视觉语言交互在它们之间直接交换信息，并使用紧凑解码器预测连续动作块。这种简单的设计直接从视觉和语言特征构建任务条件表示，显着降低了 VLA 推理的计算和内存成本。在 LIBERO 上，TurboVLA 在消费级 RTX 4090 上仅用 0.2B 参数、31.2 毫秒推理延迟和 0.9 GB 推理 VRAM 即可实现 97.7% 的平均成功率，匹配或优于更大的 VLA 策略。这些结果使 TurboVLA 成为流行的以 LLM 为中心的 VLA 范例的简单有效的替代方案，为如何连接视觉、语言和动作以实现高效的机器人操作提供了新的视角。代码可在 https://github.com/H-EmbodVis/TurboVLA 获取。

papers.title: VidMap: Exploiting Temporal Structure for Video-Based Structure-from-Motion
papers.summary: Accurately recovering the camera's calibration and metric poses for any unconstrained video would unlock large-scale training data for navigation and scene understanding. The dominant approaches to this problem are severely limited: Simultaneous Localization and Mapping (SLAM) is sensitive to initialization and transient failures due to its causal, incremental nature; it is often over-optimized for real-time operation and generally requires known camera calibration; while Structure-from-Motion (SfM) typically forgoes any image ordering, enabling optimal initialization and global optimization, but lacks robustness to visual symmetries and extreme motions. To bridge this gap, we introduce a system that combines the strong sequential constraints of SLAM with the flexibility and global optimization of offline SfM, enabling the metric reconstruction of arbitrary, long, uncalibrated videos. This system leverages recent advances in wide-baseline dense image matching, treats temporal ordering as a first-class citizen for reliable loop closure, and augments global optimization with metric monocular depth priors. As a result, thorough evaluations on diverse, challenging datasets that exhibit extreme motion and visual symmetries reveal that our approach is significantly more robust and accurate than both state-of-the-art SLAM and SfM, classical or learned, with given or unknown camera calibration. The code is publicly available at https://github.com/cvg/vidmap.
papers.title_zh: VidMap：利用时间结构实现基于视频的运动结构
papers.summary_zh: 准确恢复任何无约束视频的相机校准和公制姿势将为导航和场景理解解锁大规模训练数据。解决这个问题的主要方法受到严重限制：同步定位和建图（SLAM）由于其因果性、增量性的性质，对初始化和瞬态故障很敏感；它通常针对实时操作进行过度优化，并且通常需要已知的相机校准；而运动结构（SfM）通常会放弃任何图像排序，从而实现最佳初始化和全局优化，但缺乏对视觉对称性和极端运动的鲁棒性。为了弥补这一差距，我们引入了一个系统，该系统将 SLAM 的强顺序约束与离线 SfM 的灵活性和全局优化相结合，从而能够对任意、长、未校准的视频进行度量重建。该系统利用宽基线密集图像匹配的最新进展，将时间排序视为可靠闭环的一等公民，并通过度量单目深度先验增强全局优化。因此，对表现出极端运动和视觉对称性的各种具有挑战性的数据集进行彻底评估表明，我们的方法比最先进的 SLAM 和 SfM（经典的或学习的）以及给定或未知的相机校准都更加稳健和准确。该代码可在 https://github.com/cvg/vidmap 上公开获取。

papers.title: Vision-TL-Action: Neuro-Symbolic Trajectory Generation from Visual Observations and Temporal Logic
papers.summary: Temporal logic (TL) provides a compositional language for the formulation of long horizon robotic tasks, but existing TL-conditioned trajectory generators can sidestep perception-to-symbol binding by encoding exact object geometry in the task graph. We introduce \emph{Vision-TL-Action}, which generates action trajectories from multi-view images, a coordinate-free TL syntax graph, and the robot initial state. TL-node tokens and spatial visual tokens are fused through bidirectional cross-attention, and the resulting representation conditions a flow-matching trajectory generator. Visual tokens are augmented only with normalized image-plane locations and camera-view identifiers, while a training-only predicate-to-region objective encourages grounding to referenced objects. Consistent with prior work in this domain, we evaluate the model using Success@$K$, the fraction of tasks for which at least one of K sampled trajectories satisfies the TL specification. On Panda task, our model achieves 67.45% Success@1024, compared with 59.11% for the oracle-state baseline. On AntMaze task, it achieves 96.35% Success@256, comparable to the oracle result of 96.88%. Resolution and intervention studies show that spatial detail depends on semantic grounding and predicate identity affects both attention and performance. These results demonstrate a direct mapping from visual observations and structured TL goals to action trajectories without requiring object geometry at inference. Code is available at https://github.com/AricLau07/vision-tl-action.
papers.title_zh: Vision-TL-Action：根据视觉观察和时间逻辑生成神经符号轨迹
papers.summary_zh: 时序逻辑 (TL) 为制定长视野机器人任务提供了一种组合语言，但现有的 TL 条件轨迹生成器可以通过在任务图中编码精确的对象几何形状来回避感知到符号的绑定。我们引入 \emph{Vision-TL-Action}，它从多视图图像、无坐标 TL 语法图和机器人初始状态生成动作轨迹。 TL 节点标记和空间视觉标记通过双向交叉注意力融合，所得表示条件为流匹配轨迹生成器。视觉标记仅通过标准化图像平面位置和摄像机视图标识符来增强，而仅训练谓词到区域目标则鼓励接地到引用的对象。与该领域的先前工作一致，我们使用 Success@$K$ 评估模型，即 K 个采样轨迹中至少有一个满足 TL 规范的任务比例。在 Panda 任务上，我们的模型在 1024 年取得了 67.45% 的成功率，而预言机状态基线的成功率为 59.11%。在 AntMaze 任务上，它达到了 96.35% Success@256，与预言机结果 96.88% 相当。解析和干预研究表明，空间细节取决于语义基础，谓词身份会影响注意力和表现。这些结果证明了从视觉观察和结构化 TL 目标到动作轨迹的直接映射，而无需在推理时使用对象几何形状。代码可在 https://github.com/AricLau07/vision-tl-action 获取。

papers.title: Corrigible Assistance in One Round: Pragmatic-Pedagogic Best Response
papers.summary: Assistance games formalize human-robot collaboration under asymmetric information: the human knows the goal, while the robot must infer it from observation and interaction in order to assist effectively. In general, computing optimal assistance game strategies online is intractable, since exact solutions require planning in a POMDP. We identify a class of assistance games in which pragmatic-pedagogic reasoning resolves goal uncertainty in a single time step, rendering the full-horizon game exactly solvable by a tractable best-response procedure. Within this class, we show that mainstream inverse optimal control exhibits an inference ceiling that hinders alignment, while pragmatic-pedagogic reasoning overcomes this barrier by immediately disambiguating goals through actions that look equivalent under task execution alone. Finally, we validate our theoretical results and proposed method on a simple collaborative block-building example.

papers.title_zh: 一轮可纠正的援助：务实教育的最佳回应
papers.summary_zh: 协助博弈使人机协作在不对称信息下正式化：人类知道目标，而机器人必须从观察和交互中推断出目标，才能有效地提供协助。一般来说，在线计算最佳辅助博弈策略是很棘手的，因为精确的解决方案需要在 POMDP 中进行规划。我们确定了一类辅助游戏，其中实用教学推理在单个时间步骤中解决了目标不确定性，使全视野游戏完全可以通过易于处理的最佳响应程序来解决。在本课程中，我们表明主流逆最优控制表现出阻碍一致性的推理上限，而实用教学推理通过立即消除目标歧义来克服这一障碍，方法是通过仅在任务执行下看起来等效的行动。最后，我们在一个简单的协作块构建示例中验证了我们的理论结果和提出的方法。

papers.title: Leveraging Trajectory Graphs for Pre-Execution Error Diagnosis in Agentic LLM Systems
papers.summary: Large Language Model~(LLM)-based agents have demonstrated exceptional performance across a wide range of complex interactive tasks. However, they often struggle with long-horizon interactive tasks common in domains, such as embodied AI. The complexity and vast action spaces in these settings lead to compounding errors, where a single suboptimal action can derail an entire trajectory, causing the agent to exhaust its limited step budget on inefficient or unrecoverable paths. To overcome this without costly fine-tuning, we draw inspiration from software debugging, where execution logs are analyzed to preemptively catch errors. We propose \textit{Trajectory Graph Copilot}, a novel framework that acts as a ``copilot'' for LLM agents by diagnosing potential action errors before they are executed. At its core,\textit{Graph Debugger} models historical trajectories as a probabilistic graph and uses a Graph Neural Network to identify sequential action patterns that frequently lead to failure. Functioning as a proactive diagnostic sandbox, our method provides early warnings on potentially flawed actions, prompting the agent to self-correct. This pre-action error diagnosis prevents costly mistakes, significantly enhancing the agent's ability to complete long-horizon tasks successfully. The extensive experiments on four benchmarks with three LLM agents demonstrate a $14.69\%$ pass ratio improvement on average.
papers.title_zh: 利用轨迹图进行代理 LLM 系统中的执行前错误诊断
papers.summary_zh: 基于大型语言模型（LLM）的代理在各种复杂的交互任务中表现出了卓越的性能。然而，他们经常难以应对领域中常见的长期交互任务，例如嵌入式人工智能。这些设置中的复杂性和巨大的动作空间会导致复合错误，其中单个次优动作可能会使整个轨迹脱轨，导致代理在低效或不可恢复的路径上耗尽其有限的步骤预算。为了在不进行昂贵的微调的情况下克服这个问题，我们从软件调试中汲取灵感，其中分析执行日志以抢先捕获错误。我们提出 \textit{Trajectory Graph Copilot}，这是一种新颖的框架，通过在执行之前诊断潜在的操作错误，充当 LLM 代理的“副驾驶”。 \textit{Graph Debugger} 的核心是将历史轨迹建模为概率图，并使用图神经网络来识别经常导致失败的顺序操作模式。作为主动诊断沙箱，我们的方法可以对潜在的有缺陷的操作提供早期警告，促使代理进行自我纠正。这种行动前错误诊断可以防止代价高昂的错误，从而显着增强代理成功完成长期任务的能力。三位法学硕士代理人对四个基准进行的广泛实验表明，平均通过率提高了 14.69\%$。

papers.title: Good Rankers, Bad Objectives: Bilinear Contrastive Critics under Expressive Policy Search
papers.summary: Good action rankings do not make a contrastive critic safe to maximize. These critics increasingly act as value-like objectives for best-of-$K$ selection, planning, and critic-guided generation. Unbounded bilinear scores can let large embedding norms inflate off-support values, but cosine bounding does not remove the failure. A controlled support decomposition attributes most raw bilinear regret to norm drift. Cosine and hybrid critics nevertheless select off-support actions from most pools and incur comparable regret. Contrastive scores are weakly calibrated or inverted in the top score decile across four OGBench navigation tasks, and they fail to order fixed-query actions by value. Bellman-trained TD-Q succeeds, including in a parameter-matched function-class control. Realized costs depend on the task: simulator rollouts reveal single-step selection costs on PointMaze and the exact-$Q^*$ toy but well-powered nulls on AntMaze and HumanoidMaze, where the controller can self-correct. A training/readout decomposition traces the lost ordering to the cosine training objective; raw-trained embeddings retain weak ordering after inference-time normalization. Candidate maximization can therefore exploit false positives caused by norm drift, score saturation, or in-support misranking. Contrastive critics remain useful compatibility rankers on navigation and manipulation tasks, but action selection requires a value-calibrated scalar.
papers.title_zh: 好的排名，坏的目标：表达性政策搜索下的双线性对比批评
papers.summary_zh: 好的行动排名并不能让对比批评者安全地最大化。这些评论家越来越多地充当最佳 K$ 选择、规划和评论家指导生成的类似价值的目标。无界双线性分数可以让大的嵌入范数夸大脱离支持的值，但余弦边界并不能消除失败。受控支持分解将大多数原始双线性遗憾归因于范数漂移。尽管如此，余弦和混合批评者还是从大多数池中选择了非支持行动，并招致了类似的遗憾。四个 OGBench 导航任务的最高分十分位中的对比分数校准较弱或倒置，并且无法按值对固定查询操作进行排序。 Bellman 训练的 TD-Q 取得了成功，包括参数匹配的功能类控制。实现的成本取决于任务：模拟器的推出揭示了 PointMaze 和精确 $Q^*$ 玩具上的单步选择成本，但 AntMaze 和 HumanoidMaze 上的功能强大的空值，其中控制器可以自我纠正。训练/读出分解将丢失的顺序追踪到余弦训练目标；经过原始训练的嵌入在推理时间归一化后保留弱顺序。因此，候选最大化可能会利用由范数漂移、分数饱和或支持错误排名引起的误报。对比批评家在导航和操作任务上仍然有用的兼容性排名器，但操作选择需要一个值校准的标量。

papers.title: Context-Informed Ship Trajectory Prediction via Conditional Attention
papers.summary: Long-term ship trajectory prediction is a fundamental capability for maritime safety and autonomous navigation. While recent Transformer-based architectures have improved forecasting horizons, they predominantly rely on historical kinematic states, treating vessel motion as an isolated system. In reality, maritime navigation is profoundly modulated by extrinsic factors like weather and constrained by static vessel characteristics. Existing multimodal approaches fundamentally model the joint distribution over states and contexts, treating environmental variables as peer features rather than encoding the directional physical dependence of vessel dynamics on environmental conditions. In this work, we propose the Conditional Informer, a novel encoder-decoder architecture that formulates trajectory prediction as a conditional generation task. We employ a dedicated Conditional Attention mechanism where the vessel state explicitly queries environmental contexts through cross-attention, encoding the physical prior that weather modulates - but is not generated by - vessel dynamics. Furthermore, to address the intermittency of real-world data, we introduce a Modality Masking training strategy to prevent catastrophic degradation during sensor fallback. Extensive experiments on AIS and ERA5 data demonstrate that our approach outperforms kinematic and concatenation-based baselines by 15.4% in prediction accuracy when context is available. Crucially, Modality Masking prevents shortcut learning, reducing fallback error by nearly an order of magnitude compared to unconstrained models.
